day_local: Xuska Saint Ignatius oo reer Antiyokh, Baadari iyo Shahiid
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaaha Aabbaha ah, iyo wadaagga Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbiyow, Rabbigeennow, siday magacaagu u weyn yahay dhulka oo dhan!
homily:
Waxaa jira xilliyo maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan markii qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuustu ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arki kartaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay diyaarad yar oo uu Ben ku ciyaari jiray, ama buug uu dhigay miiska, ama xataa xusuusta qosolkiisa markuu ka hadlayo 'con chim airlines'. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'indhaha qalbiga' oo laga hadlay akhriska koowaad. Bawlos wuxuu u duceeyay dadka reer Efesos: 'May the eyes of your hearts be enlightened, that you may know what is the hope that belongs to his call.' (Ha la iftiimiyo indhaha qalbiyadiinna, si aad u ogaataan rajada ku jirta yeeritaankiisa.) Bal ka feker sawirkaas. Indhaha jidhku waxay arkaan adduunkan, laakiin indhaha qalbiga ayaa arki kara waxa aan la arki karin. Benjamin wuxuu ahaa wiil leh indho qalbi oo aad u fiiqan. Wuxuu ahaa wiil caqli badan, oo yaqaanay sida loo darsado AWS environments, ama sida loo qoro koodhka GitHub, laakiin wuxuu kaloo ahaa wiil arkayay waxa dadka kale aysan arag: baahida dadka kale iyo jacaylka qoyskiisa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel inuu barto diyaaradaha, isagoo maskaxdiisa ku dhisayay shirkad uu u bixiyay 'con chim airlines', halkaas oo uu ka qosli jiray oo uu si farxad leh uga sheekeyn jiray.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka weyn ee maanta halkan yaalla. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo qoto dheer oo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira saacado marka qorraxdu dhacdo ama marka gurigu aamuso, oo aad dareemaysaan inaysan jirin wax buuxin kara cisrigaas banaanka ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Wuxuu arkaa oohintiinna, wuxuu arkaa dadaalkiinna, wuxuu arkaa jacaylka aad weli u hayso Ben. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Everyone who acknowledges me before others the Son of Man will acknowledge before the angels of God.' (Qof kasta oo ii qirta dadka hortooda, Wiilka Aadanaha ayaa u qiran doona malaa'igaha Ilaah hortooda.) Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil Masiixa ku qirtay noloshiisa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil leh qalbi saafi ah oo mar walba diyaar u ahaa inuu dadka kale la wadaago waxa uu haysto. Xusuusnow sida uu u rabay inuu u huro lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Taasi waa waxa ay ka dhigan tahay in lagu dhex noolaado xornimada Masiixa. Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'In Christ we were also chosen, destined in accord with the purpose of the One who accomplishes all things according to the intention of his will.' (Masiix dhexdiisa ayaa naloo doortay, annagoo loo qoondeeyey ujeeddada kan wax walba u fuliya si waafaqsan ujeeddada rabitaankiisa.) Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil loo doortay inuu iftiimiyo adduunkan. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in indhaha qalbigaaga ay Ilaah u yihiin kuwo la iftiimiyey. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda ku siiyo. Maadaama aanan hadda kugu qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan igu soo gal ruuxa qalbigayga. Waxaan ku duugayaa naftayda adiga, ha ii oggolaan inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin ilaaliyo, wajigiisa ha idin iftiimiyo, nabadna ha idin siiyo. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii ka horreeyay ee naga tagay, inuu Rabbigu ku soo dhaweeyo iftiinka wejigiisa oo uu siiyo nabad weligeed ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inuu Ilaah qalbiyadooda u dejiyo oo uu siiyo rajo, xoog, iyo nabad aan dhammaanayn.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, markii aan maqlay iimaankiinna Rabbiga Ciise iyo jacaylka aad u qabtaan quduusiinta oo dhan, marna kama daayo inaan idiin mahadceliyo, anigoo idin xusuusanaya baryadayda, in Ilaaha Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, oo ah Aabbaha ammaanta, uu idin siiyo ruux xigmad iyo muujin ah oo idin horseeda aqoonta isaga. Ha la iftiimiyo indhaha qalbiyadiinna, si aad u ogaataan rajada ku jirta yeeritaankiisa, iyo hodantinimada ammaanta dhaxalkiisa ee dhex yaalla quduusiinta, iyo weynaanta awooddiisa ee inoo ah kuwa rumaystay, iyadoo la raacayo hawlgalka xooggiisa weyn, kaas oo uu ku sameeyay Masiixa, markuu ka sara kiciyey kuwii dhintay, oo uu fariisiyey gacantiisa midig ee jannada, isagoo ka sarreeya maamul kasta, awood kasta, xoog kasta, iyo madax kasta, iyo magac kasta oo la magacaabo, ma aha oo kaliya da'dan, laakiin sidoo kale midda soo socota. Oo wuxuu wax walba dhigay cagihiisa hoostooda, wuxuuna isaga ka dhigay madax wax walba u taliya oo kaniisadda ah, taas oo ah jidhkiisa, buuxnaanta kan wax walba ku buuxiya si kasta.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Rabbiyow, Rabbigeennow, siday magacaagu u weyn yahay dhulka oo dhan! Rabbiyow, Rabbigeennow, siday magacaagu u weyn yahay dhulka oo dhan! Waxaad ammaantaada kor saartay samada. Afka dhallaanka iyo kuwa nuugaya ayaad ku dhistay ammaan cadaawayaashaada aawadood. R. Rabbiyow, Rabbigeennow, siday magacaagu u weyn yahay dhulka oo dhan! Markaan eego samadaada, oo ah shuqulka farahaaga, dayaxa iyo xiddigaha aad meel dhigtay, muxuu yahay bini'aadamka inaad xusuusnaato, ama ina bini'aadamka inaad u danayso? R. Rabbiyow, Rabbigeennow, siday magacaagu u weyn yahay dhulka oo dhan! Waxaad ka dhigtay inuu wax yar ka hooseeyo malaa'igaha, oo waxaad u taaj saartay ammaan iyo sharaf. Waxaad siisay inuu u taliyo shuqullada gacmahaaga, wax walbana waxaad dhigtay cagihiisa hoostooda. R. Rabbiyow, Rabbigeennow, siday magacaagu u weyn yahay dhulka oo dhan!

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisa ku yidhi: 'Waxaan idinku leeyahay, qof kasta oo ii qirta dadka hortooda, Wiilka Aadanaha ayaa u qiran doona malaa'igaha Ilaah hortooda. Laakiin qofkii ii inkira dadka hortooda, waa la inkiri doonaa malaa'igaha Ilaah hortooda. Qof kasta oo hadal ka sheega Wiilka Aadanaha waa la cafin doonaa, laakiin kii caaya Ruuxa Quduuska ah lama cafin doono. Markay idin hor geeyaan sunagogyada iyo taliyayaasha iyo maamulka, ha ka welwelina sida ama waxa aad isku difaaci doontaan ama waxa aad odhan doontaan. Waayo, Ruuxa Quduuska ah ayaa idin bari doona saacaddaas waxa ay tahay inaad tidhaahdaan.'

day: Memorial of Saint Ignatius of Antioch, Bishop and Martyr

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!
